    r."name" AS restaurant_name,
    r."address"
FROM
    "restaurant" r
WHERE
    LOWER(r."service_format") IN ('buffet', 'coffee shop')
    AND (
        
        (r."hours" ~* '7:30am.*4:00pm' OR r."hours" ~* '7:30.*16:00')
        OR
        
        (r."hours" ~* '7:30.*4:00' AND r."hours" ~* 'pm')
        OR
        
        (r."hours" ~* '7:30\s*am.*4:00\s*pm')
        OR
        
        (r."hours" ~* '7:30.*16:00')
    );

WITH glamping_type AS (
    SELECT "id"
    FROM "accommodationtype"
    WHERE LOWER("typename") = 'glamping pod'
),
treehouse_type AS (
    SELECT "id"
    FROM "accommodationtype"
    WHERE LOWER("typename") = 'tree house'
),
snowdonia_location AS (
    SELECT "id"
    FROM "location"
    WHERE LOWER("name") = 'snowdonia'
)


SELECT
    gp."pod" AS glamping_pod_number
FROM
    "glampingpod" gp
JOIN
    "snowdonia_location" sl ON gp."locationid" = sl."id"
JOIN
    "glamping_type" gt ON gp."accommodationtypeid" = gt."id"


UNION ALL

SELECT
    th."house" AS tree_house_number
FROM
    "treehouse" th
JOIN
    "snowdonia_location" sl ON th."locationid" = sl."id"
JOIN
    "treehouse_type" tt ON th."accommodationtypeid" = tt."id";

WITH accommodation_types AS (
    SELECT
        id
    FROM
        "accommodationtype"
    WHERE
        LOWER("typename") IN ('glamping pod', 'tree house')
),
snowdonia_glamping_pods AS (
    SELECT
        gp."id",

    FROM
        "glampingpod" gp
    JOIN
        "location" l ON gp."locationid" = l."id"
    JOIN
        accommodation_types at ON gp."accommodationtypeid" = at."id"
    WHERE
        LOWER(l."name") = 'snowdonia'
),
snowdonia_tree_houses AS (
    SELECT
        th."id",
        th."house" AS accommodation_number
    FROM
        "treehouse" th
    JOIN
        "location" l ON th."locationid" = l."id"
    JOIN
        accommodation_types at ON th."accommodationtypeid" = at."id"
    WHERE
        LOWER(l."name") = 'snowdonia'
)
SELECT

    sgp."accommodation_number"
FROM
    snowdonia_glamping_pods sgp
UNION ALL
SELECT

    sth."accommodation_number"
FROM
    snowdonia_tree_houses sth
ORDER BY
    accommodation_type,
    "accommodation_number";

FROM hotels_with_features

WITH job_requirements AS (
    SELECT
        jpr."job_posting_id",
        r."requirement_type",
        r."value"
    FROM
        "job_postings_requirements" jpr
    JOIN
        "requirements" r ON jpr."requirement_id" = r."id"
),
min_requirements AS (
    SELECT
        "job_posting_id",
        "requirement_type",
        MIN(
            CASE
                WHEN "value" ~ '^[0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?$' THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN POSITION(',' IN "value") > 0 THEN REPLACE("value", ',', '.')::REAL
                        ELSE "value"::REAL
                    END
                ELSE "value"
            END
        ) AS "min_value"
    FROM
        job_requirements
    GROUP BY
        "job_posting_id", "requirement_type"
)
SELECT
    "job_posting_id",
    "requirement_type",
    CASE
        WHEN "min_value"::TEXT ~ '^[0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?$' THEN
            CASE
                WHEN POSITION('.' IN "min_value"::TEXT) > 0 THEN REPLACE("min_value"::TEXT, '.', ',')
                ELSE "min_value"::TEXT
            END
        ELSE "min_value"::TEXT
    END AS "min_value"
FROM
    min_requirements
ORDER BY
    "job_posting_id", "requirement_type";

    MIN(
        CAST(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
                SPLIT_PART(TRIM(sr."salary_range"), '–', 1),
                '[^0-9]',
                '',
                'g'
            ) AS INTEGER
        )
    ) AS min_salary,

        CAST(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
                SPLIT_PART(TRIM(sr."salary_range"), '–', 2),

                'g'
            ) AS INTEGER
        )
    ) AS max_salary
FROM
    salary_ranges sr;
